Contents of file .grepo-reference/Grepo_PRD_Package/START_HERE.md:

1 | # Grepo master PRD package
2 | 
3 | Open Grepo_Master_PRD.docx for the editable document or Grepo_Master_PRD.pdf for the fixed-layout version. Grepo_Master_PRD.md is the repository-ready source; keep assets/ beside it for image references.
4 | 
5 | The PRD contains 35 sections, seven embedded reference plates, detailed feature requirements, API behavior, universal-language strategy, IBM Bob/Watson integration, a pinned Archify adoption plan, budget controls and acceptance tests.
6 | 
7 | ## Contents
8 | 
9 | - assets/: seven unchanged original PNGs and checksums.
10 | - contracts/: core JSON Schema, six synthetic examples and validator.
11 | - design/: CSS tokens and asset-use rules.
12 | - bob/: three proposed IBM Bob skills and integration guidance.
13 | - reference/: exact inspected Grepo and Archify source links/revisions.
14 | - fixtures/: two-file synthetic source fixture for contract checks only.
15 | - quality/: requirements, tests and document-package verification records.
16 | 
17 | ## Boundaries
18 | 
19 | This is a PRD and implementation handoff, not the completed app. No source repository was changed or pushed. No paid Watson call, Bob session, application deployment or Archify runtime execution is claimed. The upstream renderer is not bundled; follow the pinned adoption reference during implementation. UI mockups contain illustrative content; mandatory truth/accessibility corrections are in Section 26.
20 | 
21 | No font files or credentials are distributed.
22 |
